metas.name: 1 · ★ 7.6 · 1933 · The Invisible Man
metas.description: A scientist finds a way of becoming invisible, but in doing so, he becomes murderously insane.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.4 · 1940 · The Invisible Man Returns
metas.description: The owner of a coal mining operation, falsely imprisoned for fratricide, takes a drug to make him invisible, despite its side effect: gradual madness.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 5.9 · 1940 · The Invisible Woman
metas.description: An attractive model with an ulterior motive volunteers as guinea pig for an invisibility machine.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 5.9 · 1942 · Invisible Agent
metas.description: The Invisible Man's grandson uses his secret formula to spy on Nazi Germany.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 5.7 · 1944 · The Invisible Man's Revenge
metas.description: An eccentric scientist helps a fugitive from the law become invisible, unwittingly giving him the power to exact revenge on his former friends.

metas.name: 6 · ★ 6.6 · 1951 · Bud Abbott and Lou Costello Meet the Invisible Man
metas.description: Two bumbling private eyes help a man, wrongly accused of murder who has become invisible, to clear his name.
